Redwood Materials (redwoodmaterials.com), Carson City, NV; battery recycling/materials and energy storage (founded by JB Straubel). Series B $40M (2020 per TechCrunch context), Series C $700M+ (Jul 2021, T. Rowe Price lead; Emerson Collective participated), Series D $1B+ (Aug 2023, ~$5.25B post), Series E initially $350M (Oct 2025, Eclipse) with final close $425M (Jan 2026, adding Google; Bloomberg reported >$6B valuation). Sum of sourced rounds ~$2.165B (C and D described as 'more than'); earlier seed/Series A not itemized. DOE conditional loan commitment (debt) excluded. Private.
